notes.title: Update on controls & Hotfix for Mac
notes.content:
On request we have made a small update to the keyboard controls of the game adding WASD keys to move the map and 'space' to pause the game. 

Also for Mac users we have changed some settings to fix a startup issue some users were experiencing. For this you might need to update your local files: Right click the game title in your Library -> properties -> Local files tab-> Verify integrity of game cache
